summary.tldr: Amends the RCMP Act to add First Nation laws to some RCMP peace officer duties and warrant powers.
what_it_does: Defines “First Nation law” to include bylaws under the Indian Act, laws under the Framework Agreement on First Nation Land Management Act, and laws made under certain self-government agreements.
Requires RCMP peace officers to help preserve the peace and prevent offences against First Nation laws, not just federal and provincial laws.
Requires RCMP peace officers to execute warrants and related duties when they may be lawfully carried out under First Nation laws.
summary.background: Section 18 of the Royal Canadian Mounted Police Act sets out the duties of members who are peace officers. This bill adds First Nation laws to those duties and to the related warrant powers.
